senses.gloss: ch. sameto cut, apportion, give to eat.
units: Targ. Y. Num. XI, 18 (ed. Vien. יַסְפִּי׳ Af.).—
<cite ref="Pesachim 3b:11">Pes. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>מי קא סָפוּ לך מאליה</he> have they given you a piece &c.? v. <cite ref="O01348">preced.</cite>
<cite ref="Chullin 107b:4">Ḥull. 107ᵇ</cite> <he>לא סְפִינָא לך</he> I should not have given thee to eat.
<cite ref="Chullin 107b:13">Ib.</cite> <he>קא סָפִית לבראי וכ׳</he> thou didst feed my son, and didst not wash thy hands (v. <cite ref="M02866"><he>מְשֵׁי</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Chullin 95b:6">Ib. 95ᵇ</cite> <he>איכו השתא סְפִיתוּ וכ׳</he> how near you came giving the sons of B. forbidden food to eat.

<cite ref="Chullin 95a:1">Ib.ᵃ</cite> top <he>מי לא סַפְיִי לך וכ׳</he> (Ar. <he>סְפָאִי</he>) should I not have given thee a portion of the fat ox? <cite ref="Chullin 95a:1">Ib.</cite> <he>דזבן … וס׳ לי</he> such and such a gentile bought of it, and he gave me of it.
B. Bath. 21ᵃ עד שית … קביל וסְפִי ליה וכ׳ Ar. (ed. אַסְפִּי Af.) until six years of age take no pupils, from six and upward take (the child) and feed him (with knowledge) as you feed an ox; a. fr.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:6:1">Cant. R. to I, 6</cite> <he>ס׳ חלא וכ׳</he> he grabbed up sand and put it in his mouth.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 114b:3">B. Mets. 114ᵇ</cite> <he>סְפִי שקול וכ׳</he> grab and take of these leaves (of Eden); <he>ספא שקל</he> he grabbed and carried them off.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 11:18">Targ. Y. Num. XI, 18</cite>, v. supra.—

<cite ref="Bava Batra 21a:1">B. Bath. 21ᵃ</cite>, v. supra.—[<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:34">Lam. R. to I, 7</cite> <he>כד תספון כלה וכ׳</he>, a corruption, prob. to be read: <he>כד מַסְפִּין כלה</he> ‘when they give a bride to eat’, some words like ‘coarse food’ being omitted.]

senses.gloss: [to be withdrawn, cmp. Nif. of אָסַף II Sam. XVII, 13; Jer. IV, 5, a. e.,] to shrink, be afraid.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 32:6">Targ. Job XXXII, 6</cite> <he>אִסְתְּפֵיתִי</he> (h. text <he>זחלתי</he>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 21:17">Targ. Y. Gen. XXI, 17</cite> <he>תִּסְתְּפִין</he> (not <he>תַּסְתִּיפִין</he>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 42:4">Ib. XLII, 4</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Berakhot 20a:6">Ber. 20ᵃ</cite> <he>לא קא מִסְתְּפֵי מר מיה״ר</he> are you not afraid of temptation? <cite ref="Berakhot 62a:7">Ib. 62ᵃ</cite> <he>לא מִסְתְּפִיתוּ</he> are ye not afraid? <cite ref="Sanhedrin 94b:19">Snh. 94ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>מהאי לא תִסְתְּפִי אלא אִיסְתְּפִי וכ׳</he> be not afraid of this one, but be afraid of &c.; a. fr.
